decision: The selected row-four PTQ1 adapter scale/history workload and recorded owned cleanup passed. Broader PTQ1 promotion remains pending.

requiredWorkload.interpretation: The three required completed streams, their caps and reported usage, generated assistant-history binding, rejected out-of-range scale, and subsequent same-owner request passed separately from lifecycle cleanup. All three visible responses were Hello; this smoke check does not establish adapter effect size or behavioral quality. Reported token usage is preserved as reported, not inferred from SSE event counts.

cleanupEvidence.scope: Independent interpretation of retained owner and acceptance receipts. This review did not inspect live processes, registration state, credentials, or model/runtime files.

budgetAndAuditCorrection.correction: The reviewer-authored audit used $host, which collides case-insensitively with PowerShell's read-only $Host automatic variable. The original audit stopped after reading five receipts and preserved a pending result. The corrected source replaces only the literal variable name $host with $hostReceipt; this exact text-only change was independently confirmed. The original source and failed audit result remain preserved.
budgetAndAuditCorrection.interpretation: One model trial ran. The first file-only audit failed safely; a corrected file-only audit completed within the same original monotonic deadline. No budget was restarted or enlarged. This later narrative review used retained evidence and a remote workflow conclusion, with no new device diagnostic, audit execution, provision, or model run.

observedTimings.scope: Uncontrolled observations from this single bounded trial. Startup brackets include broker work; readiness combines unobserved backend verification/loading/graph work and polling. Request measurements include buffering, transport, observer parsing, and receipt I/O. No controlled startup improvement, decode TPS, service throughput, or hidden token counts are inferred.

remainingBoundaries: Approved authoring checkpoint and writer/conversion provenance are not established by this lifecycle check or the separate direction comparison.
Complete state parity and generated-history state reuse are not qualified by replaying captured public assistant text.
Signed-zero/scale-two, context rejection and reuse, fresh-owner restart, extended history, and stalled-consumer cases were not run here.
Full-context and full-output qualification, performance/TPS, human creative quality, sustained comfort and paging remain separate gates.
Daily-service isolation and broker-only capability confinement remain separate gates.
